text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait to introduce added fees on work permits in 1997, Minister of Social Affairs and Labour Ahmad al-Kulaib says.
- Advertising and media fair to be held in March.
- Trade Minister Jassem al-Mudaf to chair on Monday the first meeting of the industry authority and to later hold a news conference to discuss developments in Kuwait.
- Health Ministry nurses reject a call for extending working hours to cover staff shortage. Head of nursing department calls for hiring added staff instead.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah says no decision yet on restoring ties with states which were seen as Iraq supporters during 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Islamists seek ban of three books by Kuwaiti novelists. They say the books are socially corruptive.
